title: Groupe APROSEP
description: groupe-aprosep.com guyanasso.org Groupe APROSEP (founded 1994, Cayenne, French Guiana) is a solidarity-economy network (groupement d'économie solidaire) that unites and professionalizes associations across the region, focusing on employment insertion, training and social innovation. It runs several affiliated structures — LIANE (job integration), OFA Guyane (training), GEIQ Jeun'ESS and GEPSL (shared employers for sports/youth/childcare jobs) and the Conciergerie Solidaire — all housed in "L'Accordeur," a 1,600 m² PTCE-labeled cooperative hub in downtown Cayenne supporting about 500 jobs and 240 associations. Led since 1997 by director Jean-David Poquet under president José Othily, the group celebrated its 30th anniversary in June 2025 and runs flagship projects like an AVIP integration crèche (30 places), the EVA illiteracy-assessment center and the social enterprise Tisanes de Camopi. Its partner network spans France Travail, ANLCI, Orange
